# authwise_guard_networks (Data Source)

A Guard network: a WireGuard mesh in a tenant. `cidr` is its address space inside 100.64.0.0/10, the whole of it when unset; changing it replaces the network. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `guard_networks` (Attributes List) Every network under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guard_networks))

<a id="nestedatt--guard_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guard_networks`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_network_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
